resources.string: Selected objects appear first, keep the chosen order and remain visible through filters and searches.
Tap the object name to open the object list. The island no longer has a removal button.
Open Observatory and Daily path from the island. Their title bars now keep only Export.
Types ordered by object count, alphabetical sorting options and clearer object controls.
Steadier reference labels and Nadir at −90°, opposite Zenith.
Improved moon motion, selected-object close approaches and explicit weather-loading status.
